MentionBird - Find out why AI recommends your competitor — then fix it. | Product Hunt [...] ## How to measure AI sentiment

1. Collect the answers that name you: Use the same set of buying prompts on each platform so the answers can be compared.
2. Place each mention on the scale: Mark it as recommended, positive, neutral, hedged, or warned.
3. Log the caveats: Note the exact phrases that follow your name, like "expensive" or "limited integrations." Repeated phrases point to what needs fixing.
4. Compare against competitors: A neutral score means more when you can see whether rivals are described more warmly.

Free tool

Read what ChatGPT actually says about you

Get the full answer text for five buyer questions, see whether you are named, who is named instead, and which sources shaped the answer. Free, no signup.

Get your free AI Visibility Report [...] Share

Key takeaways

 AI sentiment is about the words around your name: whether AI praises you, lists you plainly, or adds a warning.
 Most brand mentions in AI answers are neutral, so the bigger opportunity is earning endorsements rather than avoiding criticism.
 AI forms its view from reviews, comparison articles, community threads, and news, and it gives outside voices more weight than your own claims.
 The phrases that keep showing up next to your name, like "expensive" or "hard to set up," point to exactly what needs fixing, especially when rivals are described more warmly.
 MentionBird scores sentiment across eight AI platforms, with a label on each mention and a net score from minus 100 to plus 100 for every prompt.

Does appearing in AI answers actually affect sales?

More buyers now start their research inside ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini instead of a search engine. When someone asks an AI which brand to choose, the names it recommends shape the shortlist before that person visits a single website. If your competitors are cited and you are not, you are missing out at the moment the shortlist begins to form.  
MentionBird shows you where you stand and how to get named in AI results more often.

## Watch yourself become the answer [...] How does AI Ranking Advice work in MentionBird?

Choose any tracked prompt to get AI Ranking Advice. MentionBird reviews how AI platforms answer it, which brands they mention, and which sources they cite. It then provides clear recommendations with effort levels and supporting sources.  
For example, for “What are the best running shoes for daily training?”, it may suggest improving product pages, publishing a comparison guide, adding product schema, creating a shoe-testing YouTube video, or getting featured in trusted sneaker roundups.
